description: JVM layer (Maven/Gradle). Applied on top of default.json.

packageRules.description: Test libraries: the lowest risk, because mvn verify actually runs them.
Maven build plugins as a separate group.
The Gradle wrapper touches gradlew and the jar — a longer quarantine, always a human.

We do not touch dependencies whose version is governed by a BOM. Renovate does not run Maven, so it does not see that Maven will reset the version back to the one from the BOM anyway — the result would be a PR that passes the build and lies about its contents.
The Spring Boot parent and BOM move as a single whole — only then is the build a real gate.
